source_reference.snapshot_scope: current public OKX instrument fields retrieved 2026-10-12, reference scale only

rounding.arithmetic: exact decimal; no binary float or epsilon; positive finite prices only
rounding.LONG_stop: largest grid point strictly below raw_stop_boundary
rounding.SHORT_stop: smallest grid point strictly above raw_stop_boundary
rounding.LONG_target: largest grid point strictly below frozen nearest raw FTA
rounding.SHORT_target: smallest grid point strictly above frozen nearest raw FTA
rounding.quantity_contracts: floor((1/(ctVal*ctMult))/scenario_lot)*scenario_lot; reject if below scenario_minimum or zero
rounding.finite_price_rule: Every raw/order/observed OHLC and funding valuation price must be finite and >0; invalid data unresolved/STOP
rounding.observed_candle_rule: Use original OHLC as decimal values; observed native candles are not required to lie on any synthetic order grid and must never be rounded to that grid

candidate_selection: One common reference-grid protected-v3 candidate catalog and reservation order; each stress scenario re-plans only the selected candidate's execution geometry and never chooses a sibling, farther FTA, alternate POI, or replacement case.
scenario_ineligibility: Record exact reason and case ID; never remove case. Any eligibility disagreement is COMPATIBILITY_DISAGREEMENT and qualification STOP.
status_aggregation: All nine scenarios and both cost columns mandatory. Only all-scenarios finite CLOSED cases enter metrics; choose minimum scenario net_R per case and per cost column, tie by scenario ID. Different valid CLOSED exit types or funding exposures are comparable. Any filled unknown/EOF, unresolved, or eligibility/fill/CLOSED-versus-non-CLOSED disagreement forces qualification STOP; preserve worst valid CLOSED diagnostic without declaring a real CLOSED trade.
bound_claim: No finite scenario family proves a blanket conservative bound against unverified historical OKX grids, contract changes, liquidity, latency, or true account fees.
